nodes.label: Local option filtering leaves selection unchanged

A listbox tabindex=-1 avoids an implicit extra Chrome Tab stop.

nodes.label: Embedded Search avoids nested forms
nodes.rationale: Search embedded preserves its anatomy in a div with search landmark inside a host form. Typed inputProps lets the host supply combobox keyboard and ARIA attributes while Search value and accessible name props retain authority. Default Search remains a form with Enter submission.
